description: Canonical Phase 1 embedded kit. Generates an Arduino sketch that blinks the Uno's built-in LED (pin 13) at an interval inferred from the user's prompt. Flashes via Web Serial in the browser — no installer required.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. blink the onboard LED every 500ms, slow heartbeat blink, fast burst then long pause
ui.description: Generates a single-file Arduino sketch + flashes it onto your Uno via Web Serial in the browser. No installer, no admin access, no native agent — Chrome/Edge/Opera + a USB cable is the whole stack.

sample_prompts: Slow heartbeat pulse on the onboard LED
Three quick blinks then a one-second pause, repeating
